title: Positive Swap
desc: Replace one command with one positive communication swap today (e.g., 'What is the first thing you need to finish?' instead of 'Do your homework').

title: Eye-to-Eye Connection
desc: Get down to eye level and make eye contact with your child before giving any instruction today.

title: The 5-Second Pause
desc: Pause for 5 seconds before responding when your child says something challenging.

title: Active Listener
desc: Reflect back what your child says before offering your opinion ('So you felt disappointed when...').

title: No Interruption Hour
desc: Let your child finish speaking completely without interrupting them during dinner.

title: Open-Ended Question
desc: Ask your child one open-ended question about their day that cannot be answered with 'good' or 'fine'.

title: Daily Check-in Ritual
desc: Establish a 5-minute dedicated check-in time with your child before bedtime.

title: Gratitude Share
desc: Share one thing you are grateful for about your child directly to them today.

title: Calm Tone Challenge
desc: Keep your voice soft and calm even when reminding your child about chores.

title: Affirmation Note
desc: Leave a small handwritten note of encouragement in your child's notebook or desk.
